_README: Label id -> structure name for the Visible Human FEMALE pelvic floor and perineum volume (scripts/cryo/vhf_pelvic_floor_from_cryo.py), plus the mapping onto atlas entities. A KEY, not data. rule-based: markers by position rules relative to her bone and organ labels, boundaries by marker watershed on the pale septa of her cryosection photographs; compartments are muscles the photographs do not separate (mapped to null).
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), FEMALE colour cryosections (1 mm registered frame) and CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 `total` labels (vhf_total.nii.gz) as anchors and exclusions. Rules from Standring S (ed.), Gray's Anatomy, 42nd ed., ch. 62 'True pelvis, pelvic floor and perineum', and Moore KL et al., Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed., ch. 6 'Pelvis and Perineum'. Derived data (scripts/cryo/vhf_pelvic_floor_from_cryo.py), rule-based.

not_shipped.obturator_internus: the obturator internus is not a Q62 target; it is carried as a sink so that the muscle lying on the inner surface of the ischium is not attributed to the levator ani, which arises from the tendinous arch on its fascia
not_shipped.perineal_other: sink for the rest of the perineal muscle mass -- the vaginal and urethral walls and the erectile tissue of the vestibular bulb and the crus of the clitoris, which photograph as dark as striated muscle at 1 mm; it keeps that tissue out of the bulbospongiosus and the ischiocavernosus
not_shipped.superficial_transverse_perineal_right: 0.8 cm3 on this side, under the 1.0 cm3 a 1 mm frame with an 8.9 mm rms z residual supports as a named muscle
not_shipped.superficial_transverse_perineal_left: 0.4 cm3 on this side, under the 1.0 cm3 a 1 mm frame with an 8.9 mm rms z residual supports as a named muscle
not_shipped.pubococcygeus: carried inside levator_ani: no septum between the levator's parts at 1 mm
not_shipped.puborectalis: carried inside levator_ani: no septum between the levator's parts at 1 mm
not_shipped.iliococcygeus: carried inside levator_ani: no septum between the levator's parts at 1 mm
not_shipped.external_urethral_sphincter: a 3-5 mm collar on the membranous urethra: below the resolution of a 1 mm frame with an 8.9 mm rms z residual, and no label anchors the urethra
not_shipped.pubovaginalis: not separable from the medial levator ani in these photographs
not_shipped.internal_anal_sphincter: smooth muscle inside the colon label; excluded with it

levator_ani_right.note: 36.3 cm3; rule-based: the pelvic muscle funnel medial to the obturator internus band, between the pubic arch's apex and 0 mm above the ischial spine; pubococcygeus, puborectalis and iliococcygeus are NOT separated (no septum between them at 1 mm).

coccygeus_right.note: 4.0 cm3; rule-based: the sheet posterior to the anal canal from the ischial spine down 18 mm towards the coccyx. Her coccyx is NOT labelled, so the posterior anchor is a 14 mm pad of the bony hull; the septum ratio against the levator ani is only just above the merge threshold, so the coccygeus / iliococcygeus cut is the rule's, not a septum's.

bulbospongiosus_right.note: 2.7 cm3; rule-based: flanking the vaginal opening, in the superficial perineal pouch. It is the muscle TOGETHER WITH the vestibular bulb it covers: erectile tissue photographs as dark as striated muscle at 1 mm and the two have no septum between them, so the shipped mass is larger than the muscle alone.

ischiocavernosus_right.note: 2.7 cm3; rule-based: on the ischiopubic ramus, in the superficial perineal pouch. It is the muscle TOGETHER WITH the crus of the clitoris it covers: erectile tissue photographs as dark as striated muscle at 1 mm and the two have no septum between them, so the shipped mass is larger than the muscle alone.

deep_transverse_perineal_right.note: 1.9 cm3; rule-based: position-rule marker relative to her bone and organ labels, boundary by the marker watershed on the pale septa of her cryosection photographs.

superficial_transverse_perineal_right.note: 0.8 cm3; NOT shipped by name, mapped to null: 0.8 cm3 on this side, under the 1.0 cm3 a 1 mm frame with an 8.9 mm rms z residual supports as a named muscle.
